due_when.clears_when: e35-bracket-sweep dispatches and every scheduled leg either fetches candles successfully or is refused BEFORE a runner is spent on it. Either (a) the feed source is resolved per-leg from the symbol (crypto -> binance_vision, equity/ETF/futures -> whatever source the trainer sweeps already use, e.g. the source behind scripts/ops/fetch_backtest_candles.py), or (b) the planner refuses an unservable leg at plan time with a stated reason, so the matrix contains only legs that can run and the census reports the excluded ones separately. A run whose job failures are zero AND whose scheduled-leg count is stated against the 43 planned is the evidence. Reducing the matrix to the 19 crypto legs with no record of the 24 excluded is NOT a valid close -- that hides the coverage gap rather than declaring it.
